messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up 1: Zenora Labs just surfaced a multi-squad expansion. Legal + Product + Analytics want to embed summarization and in-app assistants. They expect ~5-6 teams over the next 6 weeks, projected steady usage ~1.1M tokens/day and ~75k embedding vectors/week. Renewal in ~90 days and procurement is asking for a clear cost+region plan.

aj_eng: thanks. any idea on typical request size and peak behavior? also are they insisting on any specific model variants (e.g., long-context >8k)?

maria_cs: on the sync: interactive calls avg 350 tokens, batch ingest spikes each morning (07:30-09:00 UTC). Legal wants long-context trials for doc summarization up to ~12k for some flows. They asked for EU-hosted instances.

tom_pm: thinking Dedicated pilot in eu-west plus per-team quotas. Need: capacity profile, cost estimate, onboarding checklist, and a proposed SLA. Can eng sketch a pilot config by COB tomorrow?

aj_eng: will do. rough math: 1.1M tokens/day / 350 tokens = ~3140 reqs/day => ~1.8 rps average. morning spike multiplier observed ~7x -> peak ~13 rps. with long-context models and headroom recommend sizing for 30 rps. confirm p95 latency target.
jess_success: i'll set up an enablement workshop with dev/security/procurement for next Wed. we'll gather exact team list and failure logs (they reported retry storms during spikes).
maria_cs: procurement explicitly asked for per-team billing visibility + single invoice. Also soft limits per squad to avoid runaway spend.
oliver_fin: we can produce per-route breakdowns and an invoice with cost centers. for committed pricing we'll need a T-shirt estimate; i'll draft a range once eng posts sizing.
tom_pm: aj, prototype pilot config to use for cost sims: 
```
pilot_config: "dedicated-eu-west",
capacity_profile: "2x A10G equiv baseline, burst to 4x",
expected_peak_rps: "30",
kv_cache: "enabled",
quant: "int8_mixed",
routes: ["legal-summarize","search","assistant"]
```
Use that to run cost scenarios.

aj_eng: noted. one more ask: what's acceptable p95? maria?
maria_cs: Zenora asked for "sub-second per-token latency for interactive calls" and p95 < 600ms on common prompts. They know it's ambitious but it's their target.
jess_success: pre-workshop checklist: workspace scaffolding, route-level quotas, onboarding guide, EU data residency docs, API key rotation playbook. i'll share pre-read.

zenora-bot: "Zenora: uploaded historical usage csv -> zenora_30d_usage.csv" :file_folder:

aj_eng: got the CSV. there's a consistent bump at 07:45 UTC. i'll profile token distribution and likely kernel choices, post results EOD.
oliver_fin: i'll assemble price bands: pay-as-you-go, 6-mo committed, 12-mo committed; include per-team reporting add-on.
tom_pm: owners & next steps: aj -> capacity sims + proposed kernel/quantization + E2E latency sims; oliver -> draft commercial bands; jess -> schedule workshop + pre-read; maria -> confirm exact SLO language and team list. Goal: present pilot offer in 5 business days.
maria_cs: flagging renewal risk here: if procurement doesn't see predictable cost or EU residency we move into risk lane. tagging for exec visibility. :warning:
jess_success: will create tasks on the enablement board and invite eng. please keep replies concise in this thread until we lock workshop date. :thumbsup:
